eval.answer_sql: SELECT (printf('%.2f', x) || CASE WHEN x >= 1000 THEN ' |OR| ' || printf('%,.2f', x) ELSE '' END) FROM (SELECT (CASE WHEN p.type = 'configurable' THEN coalesce((SELECT min((CASE WHEN c.special_price IS NOT NULL AND (c.price IS NULL OR c.special_price < c.price) AND (c.special_from IS NULL OR substr(c.special_from, 1, 10) <= today()) AND (c.special_to IS NULL OR substr(c.special_to, 1, 10) >= today()) THEN c.special_price ELSE c.price END)) FROM product_variants v JOIN products c ON c.id = v.child_id WHERE v.parent_id = p.id AND c.status = 1), p.price) ELSE (CASE WHEN p.special_price IS NOT NULL AND (p.price IS NULL OR p.special_price < p.price) AND (p.special_from IS NULL OR substr(p.special_from, 1, 10) <= today()) AND (p.special_to IS NULL OR substr(p.special_to, 1, 10) >= today()) THEN p.special_price ELSE p.price END) END) AS x, p.id FROM product_search s JOIN products p ON p.id = s.rowid WHERE product_search MATCH '"nba"' AND p.status = 1 AND p.visibility IN (3, 4) ORDER BY x IS NULL, x DESC, p.id LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2)
